To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 29 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 / pen-test / DPA — request to schedule a walkthrough

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. Our security and procurement teams would like to run a joint intake: a SOC 2 readiness walk-through, a short discussion about the upcoming pen-test scope, and a DPA check (we have a few redline questions).

Target duration: 60 minutes. Ideal window: June 2-4 (we're flexible across PT/ET). Attendees from our side: myself (security lead), Chris Park (legal), and a technical lead from the infra team (I cc'd security@finco.com).

I've attached our intake questionnaire and a short list of questions the pen-test vendor asked (FinCo_Evidence_Request_v1.pdf). Can you share Redwood's availability and who from your side should join? Also please confirm whether you can provide the SOC 2 summary and a DPA draft beforehand.

Thanks,
Alice Johnston
Security Lead, FinCo
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Alice Johnston <alice@finco.com>
Cc: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 29 May 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 / pen-test / DPA — request to schedule a walkthrough

Hi Alice — great to hear from you. Happy to get the intake meeting on the calendar.

We can cover: SOC 2 control mapping, evidence handoff, pen-test vendor interface/expectations, and a DPA redlines Q&A. From Redwood I'll bring Diego (security engineer) and Marissa (compliance/product) — cc'd in follow-up.

Proposed 60-minute slots (PT / local times below):
- Thu, Jun 3 — 14:00–15:00 ET (11:00–12:00 PT)
- Fri, Jun 4 — 09:30–10:30 PT

If neither works we can push to the week of Jun 7. I've attached a provisional calendar invite (proposed-walkthrough-invite.ics) and a short SOC 2 one-pager we can share in advance.

Can you confirm the attendee list and whether you need a separate technical readout for the pen-test vendor? Also please tell us your preferred timezone for the calendar link (we use PT internally).

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
